info.name: CODShield API v1
info.description:
Every CODShield endpoint, with 5,000 synthetic TEST- outcomes and 500 checks.

Quick start
1. Import the collection and the Live (or Local) environment; select it.
2. In the environment fill adminKey, adminEmail/adminPassword (first-time setup only) and newPassword (10+ characters).
3. Run the whole collection in the Collection Runner (folders 01-12, skip 13), or send requests one by one. Each request saves the IDs and keys the next ones need.

Credentials: apiKey / apiKey2 / testApiKey → X-API-Key; sessionToken / checkerToken → Bearer; adminKey → X-Admin-Key.

Remove the test data afterwards: python -m codshield.testdata purge

item.name: 01. Start here: health and stores
item.description: Wakes the server and creates two test stores with the X-Admin-Key. Saves the stores' keys to {{apiKey}} / {{apiKey2}} and the first store admin's login to {{userEmail}} / {{userPassword}}. Skip the two 'Add' requests if you already have a store and keys.

request.description: The free server sleeps after 15 minutes; the first call can take ~50 seconds.

item.name: Meta (outcome types, scopes, events, sandbox numbers)
First-time setup (first platform admin; once only)

request.description: Only works on an empty system; afterwards it answers 409, which is fine.

item.name: 02. Sign in
item.description: Logs in as {{userEmail}} and saves {{sessionToken}} (valid 12 hours).

request.description: New users get a temporary password. newPassword needs 10+ characters.

item.name: 03. API keys and webhooks (store admin)
item.description: Session token of a store user with the users permission.

item.name: Create a live key (check + report + read)

request.description: Put a https://webhook.site URL in webhookUrl to watch deliveries arrive. The signing secret is shown once.

item.name: 04. Sandbox (test key)
item.description: Uses {{testApiKey}} (cs_test_…): fixed answers, nothing stored, no quota used.

exec: const c = {}; pm.response.json().results.forEach(r => c[r.outcome] = (c[r.outcome] || 0) + 1); console.log("outcomes", JSON.stringify(c)); pm.test("outcomes: " + JSON.stringify(c), () => true);
